Lung opacity.defn: Any abnormal increase in lung parenchymal attenuation: consolidation, ground-glass opacity, pneumonic infiltrate, oedema, haemorrhage or contusion.

Consolidation.defn: Airspace filling that obscures vessels (lobar, segmental or patchy consolidation, pneumonic consolidation).

Ground-glass opacity.defn: Hazy increased lung attenuation with preserved vessels and bronchi (not a discrete nodule).

Pneumonia.defn: Infectious airspace disease of the lung (any organism or pattern).

Pulmonary infection.defn: Infection of the lung parenchyma or airways (pneumonia, tuberculosis, fungal, mycobacterial, infectious bronchiolitis).

Atelectasis.defn: Loss of lung volume from incomplete aeration (linear/plate-like, subsegmental, segmental, lobar collapse, compressive, passive, round).

Emphysema.defn: Permanent destruction of alveolar walls with airspace enlargement (centrilobular, paraseptal, panlobular, paracicatricial).

Pulmonary nodule.defn: Discrete rounded lung opacity up to 3 cm (solid, part-solid, ground-glass, calcified, micronodules, metastatic nodules).

Lung mass.defn: Morphological: pulmonary lesion > 3 cm. Remove lung cancer/bronchogenic terms from its regex.

Bronchiectasis.defn: Irreversible bronchial dilatation (cylindrical, varicose, cystic, traction); excludes bronchiolectasis.

Peribronchial thickening.defn: Thickening of bronchial walls / peribronchovascular interstitium.

Interlobular septal thickening.defn: Thickening of the interlobular septa (smooth or nodular), including lymphangitic spread.

Pulmonary fibrotic sequela.defn: Fibrotic scarring of the lung: parenchymal bands, reticulation, focal/diffuse fibrosis, honeycombing, traction bronchiectasis, radiation fibrosis.

Interstitial lung disease.defn: Established interstitial lung disease; excludes incidental interstitial lung abnormality (ILA).

Mosaic attenuation pattern.defn: Patchwork of regions of differing lung attenuation (small-airways or vascular), including air trapping described as mosaic.

Small airways disease.defn: Bronchiolar disease (bronchiolitis of any type, constrictive bronchiolitis); air trapping is a separate sign.

Cystic lung lesion.defn: Thin-walled air-containing lung spaces: bulla, bleb, pulmonary cyst, pneumatocele, cystic lung disease.

Pleural effusion.defn: Fluid in the pleural space of any type or side (simple, bilateral, parapneumonic, haemothorax, empyema, malignant).

Pleural thickening.defn: Pleural thickening, plaques or calcification (including asbestos-related pleural disease, fibrothorax, pleural metastases/mesothelioma).

Pneumothorax.defn: Air in the pleural space (including tension pneumothorax).

Tracheobronchial abnormality.defn: Large-airway disease: stenosis, malacia, wall thickening, diverticulum, dynamic collapse.

Mediastinal mass.defn: Mass or abnormal soft tissue in the mediastinum (anterior, visceral, thymic).

Lymphadenopathy.defn: Pathologically enlarged or abnormal lymph nodes at any station (mediastinal, hilar, axillary, cervical, abdominal, pelvic), including nodal metastases.

Mediastinal/hilar lymphadenopathy.defn: Enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes.

Metastatic disease.defn: Metastatic malignancy anywhere (lung, liver, bone, brain, adrenal, peritoneal, pleural, nodal, skin, lymphangitic).

Primary malignancy.defn: Named primary malignant neoplasm of any organ (carcinoma, sarcoma, lymphoma, mesothelioma, GIST, HCC, RCC...).

Cardiomegaly.defn: Enlarged heart (increased cardiothoracic ratio / cardiac chambers).

Pericardial effusion.defn: Fluid in the pericardial sac (including haemopericardium).

Atherosclerosis.defn: Atherosclerotic disease of any artery: calcified or non-calcified plaque, arteriosclerosis, atherosclerotic stenosis/occlusion, coronary artery disease.

Arterial wall calcification.defn: Calcification in the wall of any artery (aorta, coronary, carotid, iliac, intracranial, visceral).

Coronary artery calcification.defn: Calcification of the coronary arteries (CT-RATE: coronary artery wall calcification).

Valvular calcification.defn: Calcification of cardiac valves or mitral annulus.

Aortic dilatation.defn: Dilatation or aneurysm of the thoracic or abdominal aorta (root, ascending, arch, descending, abdominal).

Abdominal aortic aneurysm.defn: Aneurysmal dilatation of the abdominal aorta (including inflammatory AAA).

Thrombosis.defn: Thrombus in any vessel or cardiac chamber: venous thrombosis, DVT, pulmonary embolism, portal/splenic/mesenteric vein thrombosis, intracardiac thrombus.

Pulmonary embolism.defn: Embolic filling defect in pulmonary arteries (acute or chronic, any extent).

Medical material.defn: Any iatrogenic material or device: stents, catheters, lines, ports, pacemaker/ICD leads, prostheses, sternotomy wires, surgical clips, grafts, spinal fixation, embolisation coils, drains, tubes.

Hepatic steatosis.defn: Diffuse fatty infiltration of the liver (decreased liver attenuation), any cause.

Focal liver lesion.defn: Any focal liver lesion: cyst, haemangioma, FNH, adenoma, abscess, metastasis, HCC, other tumour or indeterminate hypodense lesion.

Cholelithiasis.defn: Calculi in the gallbladder (cholelithiasis), including gallstone-related complications.

Biliary ductal dilation.defn: Dilatation of intra- and/or extrahepatic bile ducts (drop "including biliary obstruction").

Pancreatitis.defn: Acute or chronic pancreatic inflammation (oedematous, necrotising, gallstone, mass-forming chronic).

Renal hypodensities.defn: Hypodense renal lesions (cysts or indeterminate hypoattenuating lesions).

Renal cyst.defn: Cyst of the kidney (simple, cortical, parapelvic/sinus, hyperdense, complex, polycystic, acquired cystic disease).

Renal mass.defn: Solid or complex renal mass / neoplasm (RCC, angiomyolipoma, oncocytoma, urothelial of the upper tract).

Hydronephrosis.defn: Dilatation of the renal collecting system (any grade), including hydroureteronephrosis.

Urolithiasis.defn: Calculi anywhere in the urinary tract (kidney, ureter, bladder).

Renal calculus.defn: Calculus within the kidney (pyelolithiasis, nephrolithiasis, staghorn).

Hiatal hernia.defn: Herniation of stomach through the oesophageal hiatus (sliding or paraoesophageal).

Bowel obstruction.defn: Mechanical obstruction of small or large bowel (including strangulating, closed-loop, adhesive).

Appendicitis.defn: Inflammation of the appendix (including perforated/complicated appendicitis, appendiceal abscess).

Ascites.defn: Free fluid in the peritoneal cavity (any amount).

Submucosal edema.defn: Oedema of the bowel wall (submucosal oedema / target sign).

Gastrointestinal wall thickening.defn: Thickening of the oesophageal, gastric, small bowel or colonic wall of any cause (including colitis, enteritis, proctitis).

Diverticular disease.defn: Diverticulosis or diverticulitis of the colon.

Hernia.defn: Any hernia (abdominal wall, inguinal, femoral, hiatal, diaphragmatic, internal).

Abdominal wall hernia.defn: Ventral, umbilical, paraumbilical, incisional, port-site or other anterior abdominal wall hernia.

Fracture.defn: Any fracture of any bone (acute, healing, pathological, insufficiency, compression, avulsion).

Spinal fracture.defn: Fracture of any vertebra (compression, burst, wedge, pathological).

Rib fracture.defn: Fracture of one or more ribs.

Degenerative spine disease.defn: Degenerative changes of the spine: spondylosis, osteophytes, disc degeneration/herniation, osteochondrosis, facet arthropathy, vacuum phenomenon, Schmorl nodes.

Bone lesion.defn: Focal bone lesion (lytic, sclerotic, mixed; bone island, haemangioma, metastasis, myeloma).

Intracranial haemorrhage.defn: Any intracranial bleed: intraparenchymal, subarachnoid, subdural, epidural, intraventricular, haemorrhagic contusion or transformation.

Stroke.defn: Stroke of any type (ischaemic or haemorrhagic).

Ischaemic stroke.defn: Cerebral infarction of any territory or age (acute, subacute, chronic, lacunar, watershed).

Hydrocephalus.defn: Ventricular enlargement from impaired CSF dynamics (communicating, obstructive, NPH).

Paranasal sinus disease.defn: Paranasal sinus disease or opacification of any cause (inflammatory, fungal, inspissated secretions, haemosinus, antrolith/intrasinus calcification, retention cysts, polyps).

Otomastoiditis.defn: Middle ear / mastoid inflammatory disease (otitis media, mastoiditis, cholesteatoma, opacification).

Thyroid nodule.defn: Nodule or nodular goitre of the thyroid.

Degenerative arthropathy.defn: Degenerative joint disease anywhere: osteophytes, osteoarthritis, degenerative spine disease, spurs.

Spondylolisthesis.defn: Slippage of one vertebral body on another (antero-/retrolisthesis).

Adrenal nodule.defn: Focal adrenal nodule or mass (adenoma, myelolipoma, metastasis, other tumour, cyst).

Urinary tract dilatation.defn: Dilatation of the collecting system and/or ureter (hydronephrosis, hydroureter, obstructive uropathy, megaureter).

Pulmonary artery enlargement.defn: Dilatation of the pulmonary trunk or pulmonary arteries.

Adnexal lesion.defn: Ovarian or adnexal cyst or mass.

Bowel dilatation.defn: Dilated small or large bowel loops (including obstruction, ileus, megacolon, megarectum).

Haemorrhage.defn: Bleeding anywhere, including haematoma (intracranial, intrathoracic, abdominal, retroperitoneal, soft tissue, GI).

Cyst.defn: Cystic lesion of any organ (renal, hepatic, ovarian, splenic, pancreatic, cerebral, bone, skin).

Abscess.defn: Walled-off infected collection of any organ (pelvic, hepatic, pulmonary, peritonsillar, appendiceal, soft tissue).

Fluid collection.defn: Localised fluid collection of any kind (abscess, seroma, biloma, peripancreatic collection, pseudocyst, lymphocele).

Aneurysm.defn: Focal arterial dilatation of any vessel (aortic, intracranial, visceral, coronary, iliac; true or pseudoaneurysm).

Intracranial aneurysm.defn: Aneurysm of an intracranial artery (saccular, fusiform, ruptured).

Cerebral oedema.defn: Brain oedema of any type (vasogenic, cytotoxic, interstitial/transependymal).

Intracranial mass effect.defn: Mass effect on brain structures, including midline shift and brain herniation.

Intracranial mass.defn: Intracranial space-occupying mass lesion of any cause, excluding intracranial lipomas.

Ventriculomegaly.defn: Enlarged cerebral ventricles of any cause (including hydrocephalus).

Intracranial calcification.defn: Calcification within the cranial cavity (basal ganglia, dural/falx, cortical, hippocampal, Fahr).

Arterial stenosis or occlusion.defn: Narrowing or occlusion of an artery (carotid, renal, mesenteric, subclavian, intracranial large/medium vessel, coarctation).

Coronary artery anomaly.defn: Congenital coronary artery variant/anomaly (origin, course, hypoplasia, duplication, fistula, myocardial bridging).

Acute aortic syndrome.defn: Aortic dissection, intramural haematoma or penetrating atherosclerotic ulcer.

Portal hypertension.defn: Portal hypertension or its signs: portosystemic collaterals, gastric/oesophageal varices, spontaneous splenorenal shunt.

Cholecystitis.defn: Inflammation of the gallbladder (acute, gangrenous, emphysematous, perforated, empyema).

Pyelonephritis.defn: Infection of the kidney (acute, chronic, emphysematous).

Nephrocalcinosis.defn: Calcification of the renal parenchyma (medullary, cortical).

Congenital renal anomaly.defn: Congenital renal variant: horseshoe, ectopic, crossed-fused, malrotation, duplex system, hypoplasia.

Pancreatic neoplasms.defn: Pancreatic tumour of any kind (adenocarcinoma, IPMN, serous/mucinous cystic neoplasm, neuroendocrine, lipoma).

Mucoid impaction.defn: Mucus-filled airways (mucoid impaction, inspissated secretions, high-attenuation mucus).

Pulmonary cavity.defn: Gas-filled space within a lung lesion or consolidation.

Pulmonary hypertension.defn: Pulmonary hypertension of any group (including CTEPH, PH with COPD, cor pulmonale).

Tuberculosis.defn: Tuberculosis of any site (pulmonary primary/post-primary, endobronchial, pleural, extrapulmonary, ileocaecal).

Foreign body.defn: Foreign material not placed for treatment (metal, glass, ocular, ingested, aspirated, gunshot fragments).

Diverticulum.defn: Outpouching of a hollow organ (bladder, duodenum, colon, small bowel, oesophagus, trachea, bronchus, calyx, stomach).

Atrophy.defn: Volume loss of an organ or tissue (renal, hepatic, pancreatic, cerebral, muscle).

Sinonasal anatomical variant.defn: Sinonasal developmental variant (septal deviation, concha bullosa, sinus hypoplasia, Haller/Onodi cell).

Coronary artery disease.defn: Coronary atherosclerotic disease (plaque, stenosis) — includes coronary calcification.

Post-surgical state.defn: Status after surgery: organ resection (…ectomy), transplant, craniotomy/laminectomy/sternotomy, stoma, anastomosis, resection/ablation site.

Spinal curvature abnormality.defn: Abnormal spinal curvature: scoliosis, kyphosis, kyphoscoliosis, loss or increase of lordosis.

Cardiac chamber enlargement.defn: Enlargement of one or more cardiac chambers (atrial or ventricular dilatation).

Congenital heart disease.defn: Congenital cardiac/great-vessel defect (ASD, VSD, PDA, bicuspid aortic valve, coarctation, anomalous venous return, double outlet RV).

Osteoarthritis.defn: Degenerative arthritis of a joint (hip, knee, shoulder/AC, sternoclavicular, TMJ).

Chronic liver disease.defn: Chronic liver parenchymal disease, including cirrhosis.

Soft tissue oedema.defn: Oedema/swelling of subcutaneous or soft tissues (local or generalised, including anasarca).

Anatomical variant.defn: Normal anatomical variant; kept for completeness but not a pathology.

Cerebral small vessel disease.defn: Chronic small-vessel ischaemic white-matter disease (leukoaraiosis, microangiopathy).

Salivary gland disease.defn: Salivary gland abnormality: sialadenitis, sialolithiasis, gland enlargement, parotid/submandibular lesions.

Thyroid disease.defn: Any thyroid abnormality: nodule, goitre, thyroiditis, heterogeneity, calcification, carcinoma.

Mesenteric abnormality.defn: Mesenteric fat stranding/oedema, panniculitis, sclerosing mesenteritis, mesenteric ischaemia or lymphadenitis.

Renal parenchymal disease.defn: Diffuse renal parenchymal change: chronic kidney disease, enlargement or hypertrophy, atrophy, oedema, cortical scarring.

Spinal ligament ossification.defn: Ossification of spinal ligaments: OPLL, ligamentum flavum ossification, DISH.

Orbital abnormality.defn: Abnormality of the orbit or globe: proptosis, orbital fracture, extraocular muscle enlargement, globe calcification, orbital foreign body.

Pancreatic parenchymal disease.defn: Pancreatic parenchymal change, diffuse or focal: fatty infiltration, atrophy, calcification, pancreatitis.

Congenital cardiovascular anomaly.defn: Congenital heart, great-vessel or coronary anomaly.

Uterine mass or neoplasm.defn: Uterine mass: leiomyoma, lipoleiomyoma, endometrial carcinoma.

Adrenal abnormality.defn: Any adrenal imaging abnormality: nodule/mass, hyperplasia, enlargement, calcification.

Biliary tract abnormality.defn: Any abnormality of the bile ducts/biliary tree: dilatation, obstruction, cholangitis, pneumobilia, bile-duct neoplasm, biloma.

Joint disease.defn: Any abnormality of a (non-spinal) synovial joint: arthritis/arthropathy of any cause, effusion, dislocation/instability, joint-space narrowing, subchondral cyst.

Device complication.defn: Complication of an implanted device: loosening, malposition, migration, catheter fibrin sheath.

Infarction.defn: Ischaemic tissue infarction of any organ (kidney, spleen, lung, myocardium, omentum).

Hepatobiliary parasitic infection.defn: Parasitic infection of the liver or bile ducts (hydatid, schistosomiasis, clonorchiasis, fascioliasis).

Schistosomiasis.defn: Schistosoma infection of any organ (liver, lung, urinary tract).

Pharyngeal/tonsillar disease.defn: Abnormality of the pharynx or Waldeyer's ring lymphoid tissue.

Pancreatic abnormality.defn: Any pancreatic abnormality: parenchymal disease, neoplasm, ductal dilatation or stone, congenital anomaly.

Uterine abnormality.defn: Any uterine abnormality: mass/neoplasm, enlargement, calcification, endometrial thickening or fluid.

Peritoneal abnormality.defn: Any peritoneal/omental abnormality: peritonitis, thickening/nodularity, omental cake, pseudomyxoma, adhesions, loose body, omental infarction.

Status post lung resection.defn: Prior resection of lung tissue (wedge, segmentectomy, lobectomy, pneumonectomy).

Prostate disease.defn: Any prostate abnormality: enlargement, calcification, inflammation or neoplasm.

Tympanic membrane abnormality.defn: Abnormality of the tympanic membrane: perforation, retraction, thickening, myringosclerosis.

Craniovertebral junction anomaly.defn: Congenital or acquired abnormality of the occiput-C1-C2 junction.

Breast abnormality.defn: Any breast abnormality: mass, calcification, skin thickening, cancer, gynaecomastia.

Venous stenosis or occlusion.defn: Narrowing, compression or occlusion of a vein or dural venous sinus.

Jugular bulb variant.defn: Developmental variant of the jugular bulb (high-riding, dehiscent, diverticulum).

Persistent embryonic artery.defn: Persistence of a fetal artery (trigeminal, hypoglossal, stapedial, sciatic).

Nasal cavity abnormality.defn: Abnormality of the nasal cavity: septal perforation/spur, stenosis, synechia, turbinate hypertrophy.

Dental / periodontal abnormality.defn: Abnormality of the teeth or periodontium.

Urinary bladder abnormality.defn: Any urinary bladder abnormality: inflammation, wall thickening/trabeculation, calculus, diverticulum, hernia, neoplasm.

Renal vascular variant.defn: Normal variant of renal arteries or veins.

Hepatic vascular variant.defn: Normal variant of hepatic arteries, portal or hepatic veins.

Vertebral developmental variant.defn: Segmentation/fusion developmental variant of the spine.

Airway dilatation.defn: Abnormal dilatation of bronchi or bronchioles (bronchiectasis, bronchiolectasis).

Pleural abnormality.defn: Any pleural abnormality: effusion, thickening/plaque, adhesions, retraction, malignant pleural disease, pneumothorax.

Spinal canal or foraminal stenosis.defn: Narrowing of the spinal canal, lateral recess or neural foramen of any cause (degenerative, congenital, neoplastic, traumatic).

Situs / laterality anomaly.defn: Abnormal left-right arrangement of thoraco-abdominal organs (situs inversus, heterotaxy/isomerism).

Temporal bone abnormality.defn: Any abnormality of the temporal bone, middle ear, mastoid or external auditory canal (otomastoiditis, cholesteatoma, tympanosclerosis, mastoid sclerosis, TM abnormality).

Gallbladder abnormality.defn: Any gallbladder abnormality (stones, inflammation, perforation, wall thickening, polyp, adenomyomatosis, distension, sludge, porcelain GB).

Inguinal hernia.defn: Inguinal (direct, indirect or combined) hernia; child of Groin hernia.
